"In the middle of the night, I was suddenly awakened by a strange sound-a soft, rustling, whirring noise, dark as a grey blur, staring up at me. After I had floated the length and breadth of the building I descended quietly, of my own accord, and landed lightly on the spot from where I had been taken, whereupon I walked directly out of the building without looking back. As I walked swiftly away down a gravel path someone like Barbara came running towards me in a white coat, approaching from a thick hedge that surrounded the graveyard.

'Quick', she said over her shoulder, 'don't let him get out!' But I walked straight into a wood that confronted me without a qualm."
